description: For internal approval, this checklist records decision requested, authority basis, options, recommendation, impact, conditions, required reviewers, and expiry. Its supporting evidence includes supporting analysis, policy reference, budget proof, reviewer comments, conflict disclosure, and prior decisions.

blocks.guidance: Link this internal approval record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Internal Approval Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture request type, business unit, requester, responsible owner, value, effective date, related records, and confidentiality for this internal approval.
blocks.label: Internal Approval Core Identifiers

sections.guidance: Identify request type, business unit, requester, responsible owner, value, effective date, related records, and confidentiality for this internal approval record.
sections.title: Process Checkpoint and Owner

blocks.guidance: For internal approval, record decision requested, authority basis, options, recommendation, impact, conditions, required reviewers, and expiry.
blocks.label: Internal Approval Required Inputs

blocks.guidance: Verify the internal approval condition before marking.
items: Verify delegation schedule, monetary threshold, business unit, and approval expiry
Record recusal, related-party interest, segregation of duties, and alternate approver
Distinguish precedent-setting decision, one-time exception, standing authority, and ratification
Protect board material, personnel matter, investigation record, and confidential rationale
State conditions precedent, continuing conditions, renewal trigger, and revocation event
Preserve decision citation, meeting resolution, dissent, notification list, and reliance window
blocks.label: Internal Approval Verification Points

blocks.guidance: Pair each internal approval result with a finding.
blocks.label: Internal Approval Checkpoint Result

blocks.guidance: Route outside-authority, conflicted, incomplete, regulated, privacy-sensitive, or precedent-setting decisions for review. Route unresolved internal approval work for review.
blocks.label: Internal Approval Applicable Review Boundary

sections.guidance: For internal approval, capture decision requested, authority basis, options, recommendation, impact, conditions, required reviewers, and expiry.
sections.title: Conditions to Verify

blocks.guidance: For internal approval, record supporting analysis, policy reference, budget proof, reviewer comments, conflict disclosure, and prior decisions.
blocks.label: Internal Approval Findings, Measurements, and Evidence

blocks.guidance: Cite every internal approval evidence source.
blocks.label: Internal Approval Evidence Sources

blocks.guidance: Reconcile unchecked internal approval items before release.
items: Correct checklist version and applicability are confirmed
Prerequisite documents and access are available
Each item is marked verified, not applicable, or exception
Exceptions name an owner and target correction date
Final release is within the reviewer's authority
blocks.label: Internal Approval Repeatable Checklist

blocks.guidance: State internal approval limits, assumptions, and access gaps.
blocks.label: Internal Approval Limitations and Interpretation

sections.guidance: Support internal approval findings with supporting analysis, policy reference, budget proof, reviewer comments, conflict disclosure, and prior decisions.
sections.title: Checklist Finding Record

subtitle: Internal Approval Checklist: controlled internal decision and approval record using request type, decision requested, and supporting analysis.
title: Internal Approval Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during controlled internal decision and approval record when the internal approval record must identify request type, business unit, requester, responsible owner, value, effective date, related records, and confidentiality. Complete the applicable handoff for approval or rejection, conditions, effective period, implementation handoff, notification, and retained decision record.
